blocks.html: Finolex PVC-U agriculture pressure pipes and fittings cover varied pressure and gravity flow applications in agriculture, irrigation, swimming pools and domestic water supply including potable water. Available from 20mm to 400mm O.D. in 5 pressure classes conforming to IS 4985:2000. Both Selfit (solvent cement) and Ringfit (rubber ring) joints available.

items: Light in weight — easy transportation and installation
High flow rate due to smooth inner surface
High resistance to chemicals and corrosion — extended product life
Available in Selfit (solvent cement) and Ringfit (rubber ring) joint types
Suitable for agriculture, irrigation, swimming pools and domestic water supply
Preferred by farmers, government institutions and quality-conscious buyers
Pressure Classes: Class 1 (2.5 kg/cm²), Class 2 (4), Class 3 (6), Class 4 (8), Class 5 (10 kg/cm²)
Gravity flow and pressure flow applications

Finolex PVC-U casing and ribbed screen pipes are manufactured using a special Lead Free PVC-U compound — ideal for transportation of hard, salty, sandy or chemically aggressive water. Specially designed to protect water lines from soil conditions in domestic, industrial and mining wells. Better than conventional metal pipes — lightweight, corrosion free and long lasting. CNC horizontal slotting ensures strength is maintained.

items: Excellent stiffness helps pipes withstand external hydraulic pressure
Horizontal CNC slots enable laminar flow, reducing losses at bore well entrance
Maintenance free and more economical than conventional pipes
Manufactured from special PVC-U compound with extra toughness
Increased permeability due to continuous ribs — keeps gravel pack away from slot opening
Easy and quick installation — threaded ends for interlocking without cement
Lead Free — does not alter water quality
Types: CS (Shallow — up to 80m), CM (Medium — 80 to 250m), CD (Deep — 250 to 450m)
Variants: Plain casing, Slotted casing, Ribbed Screen pipes, SDR Series Blue, CD & RDS, ASTM Dark Blue (SCH 40 & 80)
SDR Series: For well depth 12 to 24 metres — plain & slotted

Finolex PVC-U column pipes are suitable for water extraction from borewells. Manufactured using lead-free compound on state-of-the-art CNC machines. Designed to withstand the combined system load of pump weight, water and pipes with an adequate safety factor. Square threaded coupling joint ensures ease of joining and optimum load holding capacity.

items: Lead-free — completely safe for drinking water
Anti-abrasion and anti-corrosion properties ensure long life
High Tensile Strength — withstands pump + water + pipe system load
Lightweight — easy to handle and transport
High torque resistance double locking system (brass riveting) for extra safety
EPDM rubber O-ring makes joints watertight and absorbs pump vibrations
Thick-and-Thin construction — extra material at threaded ends for strength
Square threaded coupling — ease of joining and optimum load capacity
Variants: Coupler type (up to 100mm) and Bell End type (25mm to 40mm)
Pressure Ratings: V4, Crystal, Medium, Standard, Heavy, Super Heavy
Installation Depth Range: 100 to 400 metres depending on class
Locking System: Brass riveted — high torque resistance
Pump delivery pressure must be less than the selected hydrostatic allowable pressure of column pipes
Bore well drilling must be straight down without bending
Initial 3 metre GI/steel pipe must be connected directly to pump for heat dissipation during dry run
Diameter of tube well must be at least 2"–2.5" more than pump diameter
Always mount split clamp on pipe below coupler at the top
Tighten pipes by strap wrench — 50% of rubber-sealing ring on male thread gets into coupler seat
Do not over-tighten — may crush rubber seals causing leakage
Do not apply grease, oil or chemical on threads — use plain or soapy water only

blocks.html: Bell End type available in 25mm, 32mm and 40mm sizes. All sizes available in 1.5 mtr and 3 mtr lengths.

Manufacturing Plants — high pressure and temperature applications

Finolex SWR pipes and fittings are specially designed for efficient removal of waste in drainage systems. Available in two systems: Selfit (solvent cement, IS 13592) and Integrated Ring (push-fit, no solvent required). Both pipe types conform to IS 13592, fittings conform to IS 14735. Sizes from 40mm to 160mm.

items: Selfit pipes — self-socketed, one end plain, joined using Finolex Solvent Cement
Integrated Ring pipes — pre-fitted rubber ring, push spigot into socket without solvent cement
Integrated Ring absorbs linear expansion and contraction — seal stays intact
Use Finolex lubricant for easy insertion with Integrated Ring system
Complete range of fittings — IS 14735 from 40mm to 160mm
UV-stabilized, light weight, non-corrosive and durable
Soil, waste and rainwater drainage in residential buildings

Finolex underground drainage and sewerage pipes carry soil and waste from buildings to sewers or drains and then to treatment plants. Designed for underground non-pressure applications — gravity drainage, sewer flow and transportation of soil & waste discharge. Available in sizes 110mm to 315mm in stiffness classes SN-2, SN-4 and SN-8 conforming to IS 15328.

items: Non-reactive to most acids, alkalis, effluents, salt, minerals etc
Self-socketed pipes — 50% savings in installation time vs plain ended pipes
Smooth inner surface reduces frictional losses and scale formation
Does not support fire — good resistance to combustion
100% water tight — prevents ingress and seepage, ensuring hygiene
Lightweight — ideal replacement for CI and DI piping systems
EPDM rubber rings for Ringfit — long lasting, withstand high pressures
Joint Types: Selfit (solvent cement) & Ringfit (EPDM rubber ring)
Underground drainage from buildings to sewers
Transportation of soil and waste discharge

items.name: Underground Drainage & Sewerage Pipes
items.std: as per IS 15328 | 110mm to 315mm | SN-2, SN-4, SN-8

blocks.html: SN = Ring stiffness class. SN-2 = 2 kN/m², SN-4 = 4 kN/m², SN-8 = 8 kN/m² (higher SN = deeper burial/heavier load capacity). Selfit pipes are self-socketed, solvent cemented. Ringfit uses EPDM rubber ring with Finolex lubricant.

SWR Solvent Cement — for Selfit SWR drainage pipes and fittings

Primer — for preparation of surfaces before solvent cement application (CPVC/ASTM)
